title: HHHusher spec sheet
description: A dark technical spec sheet: a big two-line heading, then a table set entirely in bold mono capitals, groups divided by solid cream rules and rows by faint ones (group name, what, value right-aligned), with a short note and a yellow button in a narrow left column. Phones give each group name its own row and move the note under the table. Groups fade in as they enter; the heading rises line by line.
